description: A modern and minimalist staircase design that appears to be part of an architectural model. The staircase features wooden steps that spiral upwards within a transparent glass enclosure. The structure is elevated on a white base, suggesting it's a standalone feature or part of a larger conceptual design. The clean lines and material contrast between wood and glass give it a sleek and contemporary aesthetic. It seems designed to maximize light and visual openness, characteristic of modern architectural principles. The overall impression is one of elegance and functional simplicity, suitable for a variety of interior spaces that embrace a modern or minimalist design theme.
